visual_logic.composition: The frame is split dynamically to showcase shelter scale. ON THE LEFT: A small Pandanus-like shrub sitting in fine white sand provides minimal coverage; a tiny Pterodactylus crouches beneath its low leaves, partially exposed to the sun. ON THE RIGHT: A towering, magnificent early palm tree stretches to the top of the frame, casting a massive, deep shadow over the white limestone floor. A larger Rhamphorhynchus hangs comfortably under the vast fronds, fully sheltered from the intense tropical sun.
visual_logic.ground: Blindingly white carbonate sand and light-colored limestone nodules.
visual_logic.background: Crystal-clear turquoise water of a tropical lagoon under a high-key sky.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, direct midday sunlight with soft-edged cinematic shadows highlighting the shade zones.
